m.x: The Cache Add Event.This event is dispatched by any Cache that extends the BaseCache each time a new object is added to it.

p.x: The cache to which the object was added.
The key of the object added to the cache.
A reference to the object that was added to the cache.

m.x: The Cache Remove Event.This event is dispatched by any Cache that extends the BaseCache each time an object is removed from it.

p.x: The cache from which the object was removed.
The key of the object removed from the cache.
A reference to the object that was removed from the cache.
